decisions.reason: Floor-level shower drainage builds directly on the firm's core drainage and installation knowledge, so its absorptive capacity makes withdrawal unlikely.
As the flagship designer shower drainage product, it aligns with the firm's design and engineering capabilities and remains central to its stated direction.
Integrated slope shower elements extend the firm's existing waterproofing and drainage know-how toward low-profile accessible solutions, supporting continued learning and improvement.
Backflow-protected basement floor drains leverage proven drainage technology and technical installation expertise, allowing the firm to assimilate and refine them.
